poetryFrame.leftVertical: THE MOMENT MY EYES MET YOURS, THE WORLD SHIFTED INTO A GOLDEN HUE.

lyrics.text: The moment I laid my eyes on you
I knew you were my dream come true
I don't care if it sounds cliche
I'll say it again day after day
Still I'll find other ways to show
It's not enough just to say it's so
Look into your eyes
Squeeze your hand one, two, three times
You're so easy to love
Like the blue sky above
You're so hard to forget
You're the best I've ever met
And I'm never gonna try
To get you off my mind
Why would I?
When you're so easy to love
You're the sun after the rain
The antidote to my heartache
You could never do no wrong
You are the best part of every song
Look into your eyes
Squeeze your hand one, two, three times
You're so easy to love
Like the blue sky above
You're so hard to forget
You're the best I've ever met
And I'm never gonna try
To get you off my mind
Why would I?
When you're so easy to love
